title: Provide an option to use sessionStorage instead of localStorage
body:
In trying to comply with EU cookie law, I was hoping to go one step further than "you must accept cookies to use this site".  I'd like to give users the option to turn off persistent local storage.  

For the shopping cart, that would mean using `sessionStorage` instead of `localStorage`.  It would be nice if the SDK had a configurable option to control this.  Ideally, there would be a utility method to switch saved data from one to the other, depending on whether the user selects the "save my cart" option or the "no cookies, please" option.

In my current case, the shop function is restricted to a single page, so I *should* be able to clear storage when the page unloads. But it's not the cleanest solution.
